_meta.description: The SIMPLE structure profile, and the default one (openspec/changes/simple-structure-profile). `menu-layout.json` is the FULL profile and is untouched: an administrator brings it back with the setting `menu_structure`. Both profiles are built from the same manifest and the same fragments, so nothing is deleted and every page stays routable; this file only decides what the navigation offers first. THE FOUR STANDARD KEYS (`relocations`, `removals`, `settingsSection`, `integrationsSection`) go to the library's buildManifest exactly as the full file's do. `relocations` is ABSENT on purpose, and must stay absent rather than become `{}`. The simple menu is flat, nine entries under three captions, so nothing moves under a parent. And the library's relocation step ends by dropping every entry that has no route, no href, no action and no children, which is what a caption is: with any `relocations` object at all, the three captions disappear. THE TWO PROFILE KEYS are read by src/utils/structureProfile.js, because buildManifest's layout has no word for either. `menu` is merged BEFORE the manifest's own menu. buildManifest merges entries by id and the FIRST definition of a key wins, so an entry here that carries only `id` and `order` takes its label, icon and route from the manifest and keeps the order written here, and an entry the manifest does not know (the three captions, Woo requests) is simply added. `pages` holds page overlays: `configAppend` appends items to a list in the page's config, by key. It is how My work and the dashboard gain the links that replace the three entries this profile takes out of the menu. A link, not a waiver: tests/vitest/structureProfile.spec.js fails when an entry is removed here and no reachable page links to its route.
_meta.removalsNote: The first eight are the full profile's own removals, repeated because buildManifest takes ONE list; the spec fails when the two drift. The last three are this profile's: `PersonalQueueMenu` (Your queue) and `MyWork` (Assigned to me) are reached from the My work page, and `EndOfDayMenu` (Close out your day) from My work and from the dashboard. `SettingsGroup` is an empty shell in the manifest (a label and no route). The full profile loses it to the relocation step's clean-up; this profile has no relocation step, so it is removed by name.
_meta.settingsNote: The first six are the full profile's. `CasesDeletedMenu`, `CaseObjectsMenu` and `MailIntakeLogMenu` join them here: a recycle bin, an object register and an intake log are set-up and inspection, not daily work.
_meta.wooNote: `WooRequestsMenu` opens the Cases page narrowed to the Woo request case type. The uuid is the FIXED one lib/Settings/register.d/81-woo-verzoek.json seeds and WooRequestIntake opens requests on, so it is the same on every instance. The spec fails when the two disagree.
_meta.footerNote: The footer keeps Reports, Documentation, Store and Features & roadmap. The library's navigation has no help menu to move them under (nextcloud-vue development, 2026-10-05: CnAppNav renders main, footer and settings, and `actionsMenu.showHelpLinks` belongs to a detail page).
